settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Connect your own provider, explore its model catalog, and choose a model for each creative role.
settings.languageNote: Choose your interface language. The saved preference applies in this browser; creative text can be edited independently.
settings.providerNote: Keys live in memory by default. Official requests temporarily pass through this app’s server. Optional encrypted key storage requires a passphrase; neither plaintext keys nor passphrases are saved.
settings.empty: No models loaded yet. Fetch a catalog or use a manual text model ID.
settings.roleNote: Choose text output for Planner, Critic and Edit command. Image maker requires reported image output. Listing a model does not confirm generation access.
settings.storageNote: Brand Kits, logos, language, saved model roles and catalog metadata live in IndexedDB on this browser/profile/origin. Keys are memory-only unless explicitly encrypted. Data is not synced to another device.
settings.protectionNote: Meta planning and image generation run only after explicit consent using your own key. No server-owned credentials or automatic paid retries.
settings.aboutNote: AdMorph AI · Local Brand Kits, campaign briefs and editable concept approval. Next.js, React, TypeScript and Dexie. Meta planning uses your own key.
settings.session: The plaintext key clears on refresh. An encrypted copy is saved only if you opt in below.
settings.consent: I allow this request to send my key (if provided) to the selected provider. Official providers use this app’s server; Custom goes directly to the endpoint below. No generation will run.
settings.customNote: Use an HTTPS OpenAI-compatible base URL. The endpoint operator receives your key. Browser CORS must permit this origin. Requests never go through the app’s server; redirects are refused.
settings.noKey: A key is required for this provider. The sample demo still works without one.
settings.optionalKey: A key is optional for the public catalog; Test connection requires one.
settings.customKey: A key is optional if your endpoint allows anonymous catalog access.
settings.endpointOnly: Endpoint reachable · credential validity not confirmed
settings.generationUntested: Generation access has not been tested.
settings.availabilityNote: Only models explicitly reported available are included by this filter. Many providers do not report account access.
settings.catalogNote: Catalog metadata is cached locally after successful fetches. Unknown image/vision support is never guessed from a model name.
settings.quickLabel: Text model for Planner, Critic and Edit command
settings.manualNote: For text roles when listing is unavailable. This does not test existence, permissions or capabilities. Image maker requires catalog evidence and cannot use an unverified manual ID.
settings.manualAck: I understand this text model is unverified and may fail when generation is implemented.
settings.saved: Settings saved locally. API keys are not included.
settings.saveNote: Save non-secret provider settings and model roles locally. Catalogs are restored with timestamps and never treated as fresh access checks.
settings.imageOptional: Image maker is optional until a model reports image output.
settings.cleared: Key and its encrypted copy cleared. Non-secret model settings were kept.

hackathon.eyebrow: META GLOBAL AI DEVELOPER HACKATHON · BUILD LOG
hackathon.title: Building, one real step at a time.
hackathon.intro: AdMorph AI is in active development for the 26 October–4 November 2026 hackathon window. This page records the current working baseline and the next planned steps.
hackathon.status: Meta-only workspace · Live account verification pending
hackathon.statement: The first working baseline documented here was prepared on 26 October 2026. Development is planned to continue through 4 November 2026, with meaningful changes recorded in GitHub commits and verification runs as they happen.
hackathon.milestoneNote: The labels Day 1, Day 2 and Day 3 describe feature milestones completed on 26 October. They are not separate calendar-day claims. Future work remains planned until implemented and verified. The Meta-only expansion was integrated on 27 October 2026.
completed: Responsive English/Arabic interface and interactive sample campaign.
Provider catalog adapters, model search and role selection.
Browser-local Brand Kits, logo storage, theme preview and JSON export/import.
Optional encrypted key storage, unit tests and browser checks.
Product uploads, persisted campaign briefs, Meta planning and editable approval of three concepts. Local sample mode requires no AI request.
Meta background adapter, separate editable Konva layers, local sample backgrounds and exact-size PNG export. Authenticated paid generation remains unverified.
Automatic local design checks, optional Meta visual review and clearly separated explanations; no automatic fixes or performance scores.

Validated repair proposals, user-approved application, local verification and stored before/after snapshots with undo. Explicit Meta text/image smoke tools are implemented; authenticated calls remain unverified.

Three independent creative templates, saved gallery previews, individual PNG/caption exports, mobile creative switching and a session-wide key lock. The complete local workflow needs no provider request.

Release documentation, reproducible screenshots/browser-demo tooling, source-package integrity checks and a production-browser CI configuration. Remote publication and paid-provider access remain separate verification steps.
hackathon.plannedTitle: Planned next, within the build window
planned: Owner-operated GitHub/Vercel publication, public-site verification and final organiser submission.
Authenticated Meta integration, final demo and submission evidence.
hackathon.metaNote: Meta catalog and separately consented text/image smoke adapters are implemented. Authenticated Meta calls and image generation have not been demonstrated with a real key. The interactive sample uses bundled artwork; fixture results are labelled and do not establish live account access. Planner, background generation, Critic and repair now use Meta-only routes. Brand vision and image editing require an account-specific task test before use.
hackathon.evidence: The repository includes BUILD_LOG.md, HACKATHON.md and dated validation reports. GitHub commit history, CI run times and Vercel deployments can record subsequent actual work after upload.
hackathon.deadline: Official submission deadline: 4 November 2026, 9:00 PM US Eastern Time (5 November, 4:00 AM Cairo time). The working target is 4 November; check the event page for changes.

studio.layerHelp: Choose a layer to edit. Product and logo images are separate from the generated background.
studio.canvasHelp: Drag or resize layers. Arrow keys move the selected layer; Shift moves 10 pixels. Positions are kept inside the canvas.
studio.preparing: Loading image layers and bundled fonts before export…

studio.modelHelp: Choose and save an image-capable Meta Image maker in Settings, then enter or unlock your key. Model listing alone does not confirm generation access.
studio.userConfirmed: Image capability was confirmed by you, not verified by a generation request.
studio.consent: I authorize one potentially billable Meta image request using my key. Brand description, palette and the approved visual direction pass through this app’s server. My product and logo files are not sent.
studio.billing: One request at a time; no automatic paid retry. Cancellation stops waiting, but the provider may have already processed and charged for the request.

studio.referenceOnly: Reference only — never exported, never used as the product.

critic.title: Understand what needs attention.
critic.intro: Local checks and optional AI observations are separate. Neither predicts campaign performance.
critic.localHelp: Runs on the current layer data and measured bundled-font layout. Contrast uses a 4.5:1 target over an opaque text-layer fill; image or overlapping backdrops are marked unverified. Overlap uses layer boxes, not transparent-pixel analysis.
critic.noFindings: No issues found by these local checks. This is not a design-quality guarantee.
critic.pending: Waiting for the current images, fonts and layout measurements…

bounds.title: Layer outside the canvas
bounds.explanation: The visible layer box exceeds the logical 1080 × 1350 canvas or has invalid geometry. Inspect its position and size.

text_clipped.title: Text may be clipped
text_clipped.explanation: The unbounded font layout needs {needed} px in height; the text box provides {available} px. A glyph can also be too wide for the box. Inspect the text and adjust its box or font size manually.

copy_missing.title: Required copy is missing
copy_missing.explanation: No visible, non-empty {kind} layer was found. Restore its text or visibility if this is part of your intended creative.

contrast.title: Low text / fill contrast
contrast.explanation: This text and its opaque layer fill have a measured contrast ratio of {ratio}:1, below the local target of {target}:1. Inspect their colors. This is not a full accessibility certification.

logo_overlap.title: Logo and headline boxes overlap
logo_overlap.explanation: These visible layer boxes intersect. Transparent padding can reduce actual pixel overlap, so inspect the preview before deciding whether to move them.

asset_missing.title: A visible image is missing
asset_missing.explanation: The product image or a referenced visible image Blob is absent. Restore the image before relying on the composition.

dimensions.title: Unexpected output dimensions
dimensions.explanation: The supplied output is {width} × {height}; this campaign expects 1080 × 1350.

measurement_unavailable.title: Text measurement unavailable
measurement_unavailable.explanation: This text could not be measured with the loaded font. Clipping has not been verified for this layer.

contrast_unavailable.title: Visible contrast is not verified
contrast_unavailable.explanation: An image or a later overlapping layer may affect the text backdrop. The solid-color calculation cannot verify the visible pixels here.

meta_ui_occlusion.title: Meta UI zone overlap
meta_ui_occlusion.explanation: This critical layer overlaps an illustrative interface zone by {percent}%, above the local 15% threshold. Inspect the placement preview.

logo_product_overlap.title: Logo / product boxes overlap
logo_product_overlap.explanation: Geometric logo and product boxes intersect. Transparent padding may reduce actual overlap.

mixed_scripts.title: Layer mixes two languages
mixed_scripts.explanation: This layer mixes Arabic-script and Latin letters. Each text layer must be in exactly one language; a Latin brand name stays in its own brand layer.

direction_mismatch.title: Text direction conflicts with its content
direction_mismatch.explanation: This layer's forced direction does not match its text. Reset the direction to automatic so the content decides.

cta_off_brand.title: CTA uses non-brand colors
cta_off_brand.explanation: The CTA button uses {fill} / {color}, which are not brand colors. The fix recolors it to the darkest brand color with the lightest readable brand text.

critic.aiHelp: A potentially billable visual opinion on a reduced preview and layer details. The model may miss issues or be wrong. It does not modify the design.
critic.modelHelp: Uses the saved Meta Critic role. Image input and structured text output are required. Incomplete catalog metadata does not prove support.
critic.incompatible: Choose a Meta Critic that supports image input in Settings. Known text-only or unavailable models cannot review the preview.
critic.consent: I agree to send a rendered preview containing my product, logo and copy, plus editable layer details and caption, through this app’s server to Meta with my key for one potentially billable review.
critic.opinionBadge: AI opinion · not a measured fact
critic.notEvidence: These observations are not verified evidence, a quality score, legal approval or a forecast of clicks or conversions.
critic.stale: This review describes an older layout or another interface language. It has not been applied to the current version. Run another review only if you choose to.
critic.sessionOnly: Review available in this session only
critic.noAiFindings: The model returned no observations. That does not establish that the design has no issues.
critic.manualOnly: Repair proposals require your approval. Preview the exact differences, apply only a verified proposal, and keep the original snapshot for undo.

repair.title: Propose, verify, then apply.
repair.intro: Review exact changes before applying. Local proposals use measurements; optional AI proposals are unverified suggestions. Nothing is applied automatically.
repair.localReason: Target measured text clipping, solid-fill contrast, hidden existing copy and geometric logo overlap. Original text and image assets are preserved.
repair.aiHelp: Uses your saved Meta Edit command model with image input. A proposal can change copy; inspect every difference. The server validates an action allowlist and the browser checks the result before approval.
repair.consent: I authorize one potentially billable Meta repair-planning request with my key. A rendered preview containing my product/logo/copy, layer details and caption pass through this app’s server. This only proposes changes; it does not apply them.
repair.aiButton: Ask Meta for a repair plan
repair.limit: This repair cycle reached two approved passes. No further loop or paid request runs automatically. Inspect unresolved issues and make a manual edit before starting a new cycle.
repair.stale: This proposal belongs to an older layout or interface language. Generate a new proposal before applying.
repair.empty: No safe changes were proposed. Missing assets/copy or unresolved layout problems may need manual work.
repair.clamped: The differences below show effective clamped values. Image references and layer identities cannot be changed by a repair plan.
repair.limits: Counts cover local warnings/errors only. Unverified checks remain unverified; fewer findings do not prove creative quality or campaign performance.
repair.regression: The proposal introduces or worsens a local finding. Applying is blocked; inspect the proposal or make manual changes.
repair.sessionOnly: Snapshots available in this session only
repair.currentAfter: The current layout matches the repaired snapshot. Local checks have run again.
repair.currentBefore: The current layout matches the original snapshot.
repair.laterEdits: The design has later edits. Snapshot undo/redo is disabled to preserve those changes.
repair.comparisonHelp: These images are rendered from saved layer snapshots, without changing the editable canvas. Proposed results are not applied until you choose Apply fixes.
repair.afterAlt: Composition after the proposed or approved repair

metaSmoke.ack: I checked that this Meta model supports the selected request type. This is required when catalog capability metadata is incomplete.
metaSmoke.needKey: Enter or unlock a Meta key in the provider settings above.

metaSmoke.live: Meta returned a live smoke response
metaSmoke.fixture: Synthetic fixture · not live Meta evidence
metaSmoke.imageAlt: Image returned by the Meta smoke request
metaSmoke.limits: This verifies only the completed request and model, not every provider feature or account permission. No automatic retry. Evidence exports contain no key or image bytes.

autoRun.zipSkipped: Some images were skipped in the ZIP.

cutout.title: Cut out a product
cutout.description: Upload a product photo and isolate it from its background without changing its pixels. Cutting runs locally in your browser and sends no image to Meta.
cutout.providerUnavailable: Meta (SAM) cutout unavailable: enter a Meta key and choose a segmentation model in Settings.
cutout.unreliable: Unreliable cutout — try a photo with a simpler background or use the original.
cutout.tooLarge: The photo is too large or exceeds the allowed dimensions.
cutout.decodeFailed: Could not read the photo. Try another file.
cutout.cutoutFailed: Could not cut out the photo. Try another photo or use the original.
cutout.saveFailed: Could not save the cutout. Try again.

warnings.empty_foreground: No clear product was found in the photo.
warnings.background_not_removed: The background was not removed — the photo is almost one solid color.
warnings.foreground_small: The visible product is very small.
warnings.foreground_large: The product fills almost the whole photo.

cutout.samEmpty: SAM found no product in the photo. Try a clearer photo or use the local cutout.
cutout.samFailed: SAM cutout failed. You can retry or use the local cutout.
cutout.samFallbackNote: SAM cutout failed, so the local cutout was used instead.
cutout.descriptionSam: Upload a product photo and isolate it with Meta SAM. The product photo is sent to Meta when this provider is chosen; product pixels never change.
cutout.roughBottomNote: The cutout edge looks rough at the base — props touching the product may have confused the cut. Try a cleaner photo, or cut again.

creativeSet.title: One campaign. Three creative directions.
creativeSet.help: Approve all three concepts, then build three editable local designs. No key, upload to a provider or paid request is needed.
creativeSet.approvalRequired: Approve all three concepts to prepare the complete set. Each approved concept can also open its own editor.
creativeSet.preserve: Existing saved designs and edits are reused, never replaced. New templates follow each concept’s angle. Open the editor to change retained copy or request one AI background at a time.
creativeSet.saved: Three designs saved in this browser.
creativeSet.session: Three designs are available in this session only. Download them before leaving.
creativeSet.error: The saved design set could not be loaded or saved. Existing work was preserved; try again or open an approved editor.
creativeSet.preparing: Preparing preview. Export stays disabled while a font or image is unavailable.
creativeSet.caption: Download caption
creativeSet.empty: Your editable design will appear here. Approval does not send an AI request.
creativeSet.stale: Saved design retained. Review changed campaign inputs and reapprove its concept before further generation.

publicMode.title: Your keys. Your choice.
publicMode.help: The public demo uses local artwork and templates. This app has no shared owner-funded generation key. Every AI request uses your own entered or unlocked key and explicit consent.
publicMode.storage: Project files stay in this browser. Plaintext keys stay in memory; encrypted storage is optional and requires your passphrase to unlock after reload.
publicMode.locked: Session keys are locked. Local editing, repairs and exports remain available.
publicMode.unlocked: A provider key is available in this session. Lock session keys before leaving a shared computer.
publicMode.cancelLimit: Locking clears all providers’ in-memory keys and request consent and cancels pending UI requests. It cannot reverse a request the provider already received or charged.
publicMode.noRemote: Locking preserves projects, selected model roles and encrypted credentials. To remove an encrypted copy, use Forget stored key in its provider settings.

meta.only: Meta is the only active AI provider. Local samples stay on this device.
meta.legacy: Inactive provider choices and encrypted credentials were preserved. Choose Meta models to enable new AI work.
meta.keyNote: Plaintext keys stay in memory. Saved checks are account- and task-specific and expire after 24 hours.
meta.paidConsent: I authorise one request for the chosen task. Tests may generate an image and incur charges. No automatic paid retries.
meta.cost: Pricing or token cost is unknown unless returned by the provider. Account access is not proven by a model listing.
meta.unknown: Choose a fetched model or enter an authorised model ID and save. Tests and cached support labels are optional diagnostics and never unlock or block generation.
meta.verified_supported: Verified by a successful task response
meta.verified_unsupported: Last check reported unsupported; you can still retry
meta.testPassed: Optional test completed. Tests do not unlock or block any task.
meta.logoAuto: Automatically place the original logo in new designs
meta.visionRequirement: Choose a vision model here, or use your saved Planner model. Upload an image and authorise extraction. Model tests are optional.
meta.shareImage: I authorise one potentially billable request sharing this image with Meta through this app server.
meta.sampleReason: Local illustrative sample; no AI request or image analysis occurred.
meta.sample: LOCAL SAMPLE · not a live AI response
meta.imageError: The image could not be safely decoded. Use PNG, JPEG or WebP within the upload limits.
meta.aiError: The request failed. Check the selected task, account access or provider response.
meta.copyClipped: Actual canvas text measurement does not fit. Resize or adjust the font before applying.
meta.originalKept: The original is immutable. Accepting a variant affects future concepts; saved designs are never silently replaced.
meta.editRequirement: Choose an image-edit model, or use your saved image model, and authorise this request. No preliminary model test is required.
meta.packagingRisk: Image editing can change packaging or lettering. Compare the original before accepting. Local sample applies a labelled on-device filter only.
meta.enhanceOnly: Enhance only: the product shape, colors and lettering stay as they are.
meta.variantSaved: Variant saved separately; saved designs retained.
meta.storageProblem: Storage failed. The original and previous saved work were retained.
meta.zoneDisclaimer: Illustrative Feed/Reels UI zones, scaled to the current canvas. These are planning approximations, not permanent official specifications. Overlays and issue markers are excluded from PNG.
meta.markers: Show numbered review markers in Review
meta.notReady: Wait for fonts and images before export or measurement.
meta.preflightNote: Review findings and partial checks; this is not a full accessibility or campaign-performance certification.
meta.manualNeeded: No safe automatic change was found for this issue. Inspect the layer manually.
meta.backupHelp: Binary backup includes Brand Kits, campaigns, editable designs, original/variant image Blobs, repair history and saved versions. Keys, encrypted credentials, provider settings and account verification records are excluded.
meta.restoreConflict: Restore is additive. Conflicting existing IDs cause a rollback; existing projects and keys are never overwritten. Restore into an empty browser origin to recover a different snapshot.
meta.backupError: Backup or restore failed validation, storage limits or an existing-record conflict. Current records were retained.
meta.restoreDone: Project data restored. Reload to open the restored records.

errors.missing_key: Enter a key before testing this connection or fetching this provider’s catalog.
errors.consent: Accept the request consent before contacting a provider.
errors.invalid_request: The request is invalid. Check the provider and key fields.
errors.custom_server: Custom endpoints cannot be forwarded by this server. Use the direct browser connection.
errors.origin: This request must come from this app’s origin.
errors.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTPS base URL with no username, password, query string or fragment.
errors.unauthorized: The provider rejected this key. Check that it is valid and active.
errors.forbidden: Access denied. Check account permissions, region and model access.
errors.rate_limit: The provider is rate limiting requests. Automatic retries finished; wait and retry.
errors.quota: The provider reports exhausted quota or insufficient credits. Check your provider account.
errors.invalid_model: The provider could not find this endpoint or model. Check compatibility and the model ID.
errors.timeout: The provider timed out. Check your connection and try again.
errors.network: The provider could not be reached. Check your connection and retry.
errors.cors: The browser could not reach this endpoint. Check CORS, HTTPS, certificates and redirects.
errors.invalid_response: The provider returned an unsupported or malformed catalog. Try again or use a manual text model ID.
errors.upstream: The provider request failed. Check the provider status and account, then retry.
errors.catalog_limit: The catalog exceeded safety limits or returned repeating pagination. No partial catalog was accepted.
errors.role_capability: This model does not report the capability required for that role. Image maker needs image output; other roles need text output.
errors.manual_id: Enter a valid Meta model ID; paths with dot traversal and query parameters are not allowed.
errors.manual_ack: Acknowledge the limitations before assigning an unverified model.
errors.incomplete_roles: Select models for Planner, Critic and Edit command before saving. Image maker is optional.
errors.storage_error: Could not update local storage. No plaintext key was stored.
errors.campaign_input: Check the image, brief and selected model, then confirm consent before trying again.
errors.product_image: Choose a valid PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
errors.product_size: The product image must be 2 MB or smaller.
errors.product_dimensions: Each image side must be 4096 pixels or smaller.
errors.unsupported_planner: This model or request is not supported. Choose a Meta model with image input and structured output.
errors.plan_invalid: The planner returned an incomplete or invalid plan. Your previous concepts have been kept.
errors.plan_blocked: Meta declined this request. Review the image and brief before trying again.
errors.plan_truncated: The response reached its output limit. Your previous concepts have been kept; try a shorter brief or another model.
errors.image_input: Approve the concept, choose a compatible image model and confirm consent before requesting a background.
errors.image_response: The provider did not return a usable supported image. Your existing design has been kept.
errors.image_model: This model or image request is not supported. Check image output capability and your account access.
errors.export_error: The PNG could not be exported. Wait for fonts/images to load and try again.
errors.review_input: Check the preview, saved Critic and explicit image-sharing consent.
errors.review_invalid: The Critic returned an invalid or unsupported review. The previous review and design are unchanged.
errors.review_preview: The review preview must be a valid 540 × 675 JPEG, at most 512 KB.
errors.repair_invalid: The repair plan is invalid or unsupported. Your current design is unchanged.
errors.repair_stale: The design changed after this proposal. Generate a new proposal before applying or restoring a snapshot.
errors.repair_assets: The comparison cannot render because required images differ or are not loaded. Your design is unchanged.
errors.meta_response: Meta did not return a supported smoke response. Check the selected model and account access; no automatic retry ran.
errors.meta_only: Only Meta is active. Inactive provider records were preserved.
errors.unsupported_task: Meta explicitly rejected support for this task. Choose another model.
errors.unverified_task: Verify this task with the current key/model before using it.

meta.invalidRecords: Some stored records are invalid. They were preserved and skipped; valid model choices and projects remain available.
meta.offline: Offline: editing, local saves and PNG export remain available in this open session. Meta requests need a connection.
meta.catalogNote: Fetch models reads the account catalog only. Clicking it authorises this metadata request; it does not generate content. Choose a model for each task below and save. A successful task test also saves its selected model.
meta.noModels: Meta returned an empty catalog for this account. You can still enter an authorised model ID manually.
meta.localCheck: Optional request check on app server · no Meta call
meta.localCheckPassed: Local image, model ID and output schema are valid. No Meta request was sent.
meta.polishHelp: Shadow and grade are derived overlays: product pixels never change.

remix.descriptionVariants: Pick a finished ad from your gallery and make 2 or 3 new versions of it with different headlines and scenes.
remix.descriptionThemes: Pick a finished ad from your gallery and restyle it for a season.
remix.needKey: Add your Meta API key in Settings first.
remix.emptyGalleryHint: Generate an ad in One-shot first — finished ads save to this gallery automatically.
remix.deleteFailed: Could not delete the saved ad.
remix.failedSome: Some copies failed; the ones below succeeded.

oneshot.title: One-shot ad studio
oneshot.subtitle: Arrange your product, logo and words on a canvas, then let Meta paint the finished ad.
oneshot.defaultScene: Bright modern studio scene with soft daylight
oneshot.canvasHelp: Drag elements with touch or mouse. Select one to resize it or delete it.
oneshot.enhance: Improve product (cleaner materials and light, same shape and writing)
oneshot.enhanceFailed: Improvement failed; kept the original cutout.
oneshot.enhanceNeedsSetup: Improving needs a Meta key, an image model, and consent — check Settings and the consent box, then try again.
oneshot.enhanceDone: Product improved — compare it with the original below.
oneshot.missingKey: Add your Meta key in Settings and pick an image model first.
oneshot.needProduct: Upload a product photo, then press Isolate background.
oneshot.needBrand: Write a brand name and description first.
oneshot.uploadHintProduct: A clear photo of one product, front-facing if possible.
oneshot.uploadHintLogo: PNG or JPG with a transparent or plain background works best.
oneshot.uploadHintIcon: A small flat graphic to place on the canvas.
oneshot.brandLogoMissing: This brand's saved logo could not be loaded, so no logo is shown.
oneshot.resultEmpty: Your finished ad will appear here.
oneshot.selectedControls: Move and resize the selected element
oneshot.findingLowContrast: Text contrast is too low on the mockup
oneshot.findingSafeZone: Text is too close to the edge
oneshot.cutoutTapHint: The automatic cutout could not find the product. Tap the product in the photo and it will be cut out from that point.
